claims.assertion: Athena says Federation jurisdictions rise through density levels, whose members’ perceptions and ethical frameworks differ; higher-level beings view Earth as a self-contained experience entered at one’s own risk.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)

claims.assertion: Athena says higher beings regard Earth suffering as brief learning and claim detailed guidance over Earth events to preserve the bounded experience.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)

claims.assertion: Athena says humans are a Lyrian-derived biological suit shared by multiple species; the Federation considers humanity already interstellar and would not permit human-style expansion beyond Earth.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
